Done. `/home/bench/results/closure.json` contains the result.

**Method**
- Extracted specifiers with a comment-stripping scanner (strings preserved) plus a statement-anchored regex for `import … from "S"`, `export … from "S"`, and bare `import "S"`. Dynamic `import("…")` was excluded per spec. I cross-validated the extraction two ways (raw vs. comment-stripped, anchored vs. permissive `from "…"` scan); the only differences were a JSDoc example in `core/extensions/types.ts` (`import { CustomEditor } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent"` inside a comment — correctly dropped) and test files outside `src`.
- Resolution: relative `.js`→`.ts`, directory→`index.ts`, workspace package name→`<pkg>/src/index.ts` (names: `@earendil-works/pi-ai` → `packages/ai`, `pi-agent-core` → `packages/agent`, `pi-tui` → `packages/tui`, `pi-coding-agent` → `packages/coding-agent`), subpaths tried `src/<sub>.ts`, `src/<sub>/index.ts`, `src/providers/<sub>.ts` (e.g. `pi-ai/mcp`, `pi-ai/oauth`, `pi-ai/bedrock-provider`). Only two specifiers failed to resolve anywhere in the repo, both irrelevant (`./types.js` in `packages/ai/scripts/generate-models.ts`, and `./dist/bedrock-provider.js` in a `.d.ts` shim).
- Reachability computed by BFS on the reversed graph from `packages/ai/src/types.ts`, so cycles are handled naturally.

**Results**
- `total_ts_files_scanned`: 267
- `transitive_importer_count`: 187
- `direct_importer_count`: **0** — this is genuine, not a bug: no file under `packages/coding-agent/src` uses the specifier `@earendil-works/pi-ai/types` (the only spec that would resolve to `packages/ai/src/types.ts` from outside that package). They go through `@earendil-works/pi-ai` → `packages/ai/src/index.ts`, which re-exports `./types.js`, or via `@earendil-works/pi-agent-core`. Example verified path: `cli/args.ts` → `agent/src/index.ts` → `agent/src/agent.ts` → `ai/src/index.ts` → `ai/src/types.ts`.
